scope_decision: Implement only static_landing_page drafts: Korean request, deterministic HTML/CSS preview, revision, rollback, and owner approval pending. Keep visual platform dialogue and tenant console authentication intact. 3D character Addon is documented as future architecture and labelled readying only; no external service, upload, download, or generation is wired. Add a guidance-only external connection readiness contract and a beginner journey UI linking to official GitHub, Meshy, and Netlify onboarding documentation. No external authorization, credential handling, Meshy job, repository write, or deploy is implemented. Follow-up correction: legacy schema 1.0 documents without readiness remain readable after their original digest check; the public response injects the immutable guidance contract. ARKAON has no GitHub App or Netlify connection, so UI says those features are unavailable and links are reference only. Delta-audit correction: new documents do not persist readiness; it is a response projection only. Read compatibility accepts recognized prior readiness variants or absence after validating the original document digest, but no persisted readiness is trusted as authorization or connection evidence. Visual exploration is explicitly HOLD. Add a first complete artifact, logo_svg: deterministic geometry/text SVG only, three local studies, selection, edit, rollback, and owner-authorized download. Credit cap is now 500; no meter is available, so no consumption claim is made. Sol review delta: restore logo revisit through owner list and draft_id URL, synchronize loaded revision inputs, mark previews separately from saved selection, require latest revision digest for rollback, and limit SVG text to XML 1.0 allowed code points. UX delta: reshape the local logo UI into a guided owner journey with explicit input, three previews, saved selection, revision restore, SVG download, accessible loading/error states, and navigation to site drafts and console. This remains deterministic SVG only; no external image generation, external integration, repository write, deploy, or credit consumption claim is added.
investigation: Luna findings supplied through the orchestrator: consumer path needs a coherent home-to-preview journey; no executable generation or deployment in the first vertical slice. Official public documentation checked 2026-09-23: GitHub Apps provide repository-scoped installation/authorization; Meshy requires an account and API key for API use; Netlify installs its GitHub App when linking a repository and deploys after a repository push. User authorized a 500-credit cap and requested the simplest artifact first; no consumption meter exists in this environment.
